senses.gloss: m. (denom. of קָנֶה) a reed basket, contrad. to סַל, a common wicker basket.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:8">Bets. I, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 14b">14ᵇ</cite>) (missing in Ms. M.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Tosef. ib. I, 20; Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ bot.; a. e.—Pl. <he>קְנוֹנִים</he>, <he>קְנוֹנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:3">Kel. XVI, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 13</cite> (not <he>קני׳</he>).
